newsitem.title: GREECE: CANADA SUPPORTS PEACEFUL RESOLUTION FOR CYPRUS.
newsitem.headline: CANADA SUPPORTS PEACEFUL RESOLUTION FOR CYPRUS.

text.p: Canada's Foreign Minister, Lloyd Axworthy expressed concern over increased violence in Cyprus and said a peaceful settlement should be sought, the Athens News Agency (ANA) said on Monday.
Greek parliament president Apostolos Kaklamanis had written to Axworthy to inform him of Greece's condemning stance on the recent cold-blooded murders of three Greek Cypriots.
Axworthy wrote a reply letter in which he said that Canada was in favour of a United Nations resolution on the withdrawal of Turkish occupation forces from Cyprus, the ANA statement said.

"Canada's aim is to help reduce tension in Cyprus and contribute to constructive negotiations for peace in the region," Axworthy was quoted as saying. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
